title: Netflix Announces a Collaboration With Filmin, With a Monthly Collection of Films and Documentaries
summary: Netflix has launched a new collaboration with independent Spanish streamer Filmin, giving Netflix members in Spain access to a monthly selection of films and documentaries, curated by Filmin’s editorial team.
body_markdown:
[Download the images available](https://assetshare.netflixstudios.com/43ff0d12-1351-46bf-b8fc-8b4548383126)


Netflix has launched a new collaboration with independent Spanish streamer Filmin, giving Netflix members in Spain access to a monthly selection of films and documentaries, curated by Filmin’s editorial team.


-


The first collection is


[October Mysteries from Filmin](https://netflix.com/filmin) , in time for Halloween season.


-


Thanks to this agreement, members will have more film and documentary options, with new collections curated by Filmin rotating each month.


Starting today, October 1, 2026, Netflix members in Spain will find the first collection, "October Mysteries," available in its own section on the service. A new collection of 10 titles, licensed and selected by Filmin, will be added to Netflix on the first day of every month, while the previous month's collection will remain available to stream for one more month.


This agreement gives titles already beloved on Filmin the chance to reach a wider audience, with monthly themes changing with the seasons, such as mystery for Halloween, or award-winning films around the Academy Awards.


"We deeply admire Filmin's commitment to film and documentaries. They've built a very close relationship with a discerning, specialized audience, while at Netflix we work every day with the focus of entertaining the world's largest and most diverse audience. That combination makes us perfect partners: together we can offer our audience even more films and documentaries to enjoy handpicked by Filmin's editorial team."


said Diego Ávalos, Netflix’s VP of Content for Spain, Portugal and Turkey.


"The fact that the world's largest streaming service has taken notice of us represents enormous recognition of the nearly 20 years of work and love for cinema behind our project,"


said Juan Carlos Tous, CEO and founder of Filmin.


"Our goal is to bring the cinema we're passionate about to the widest possible audience, and this alliance with Netflix gives us a unique opportunity to achieve that."
